title: Al-Humazah 104:7-9 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Humazah 104:7-9 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 19. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ (٧) إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ (٨) فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ (٩)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Humazah 104:7-9 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 104:7-9 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Say all of Al-Humazah to a friend.

questions.a: A) 9. Al-Humazah has 9 ayat; we now know them all.

questions.q: Think again: The surah ends by describing the Fire closing over those who mocked. What should we do now so that never happens to us?
questions.a: Speak kindly, share, and ask Allah's forgiveness.
